description: Implement the three feature pages (Dashboard, Clients, Projects), their modals (ClientModal, ProjectModal), and the Supabase SQL migrations. This is the final user-facing feature layer. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete — requires the type definitions, supabase singleton, and layout components from those features.
steps: Create src/db/migrations/001_create_clients.sql: CREATE TABLE public.clients (id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, company text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', email text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', location text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', notes text, is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); ALTER TABLE public.clients ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY 'Authenticated admins only' ON public.clients FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$; CREATE TRIGGER clients_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.clients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.handle_updated_at();

Create src/db/migrations/002_create_projects.sql: CREATE TABLE public.projects (id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title text NOT NULL, description text, service text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', budget numeric(12,2), start_date date, deadline date, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending' CHECK (status IN ('Pending','In Progress','Completed','On Hold')), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX projects_client_id_idx ON public.projects(client_id); CREATE INDEX projects_status_idx ON public.projects(status); ALTER TABLE public.projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY 'Authenticated admins only' ON public.projects FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true); CREATE TRIGGER projects_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.projects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.handle_updated_at();

Create src/components/ClientModal.tsx: a modal overlay (fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50) containing a white card (max-w-lg, rounded-lg). Props: isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; client?: Client (undefined = add mode); onSaved: (client: Client) => void. Form fields: Name (required), Company, Email, Phone, Location, Notes (textarea). On submit: if client?.id exists, call supabase.from('clients').update({...}).eq('id', client.id).select().single() else call supabase.from('clients').insert({...}).select().single(). On success call onSaved with returned data and onClose. Show inline error on Supabase error. Cancel button calls onClose. Submit button label: 'Save Client'. All inputs styled with Tailwind: border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 w-full focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy.

Create src/components/ProjectModal.tsx: same modal pattern as ClientModal. Props: isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; project?: Project; clients: Client[]; onSaved: (project: Project) => void. Form fields: Title (required), Client (select dropdown from clients prop, required), Service (text input, required), Description (textarea), Budget (number input), Start Date (date input), Deadline (date input), Status (select: Pending / In Progress / Completed / On Hold). On submit: insert or update in supabase projects table. Same error/success pattern as ClientModal.

Create src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: on mount, fetch stats from Supabase in parallel using Promise.all: (1) count of all non-archived clients via supabase.from('clients').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('is_archived', false), (2) count of active projects (status In Progress), (3) count of completed projects, (4) count of pending projects — all from the projects table. Show a loading skeleton while fetching. Render four stat cards in a responsive grid (2 cols mobile, 4 cols desktop). Each card: icon (lucide-react), label, count. Card styling: white background, rounded-xl shadow, border-l-4 with brand color accent (navy for clients, gold for active, brand_red for pending, green-500 for completed). Below the stat cards, render a 'Recent Projects' table showing the 5 most recently created projects (select title, status, deadline, and joined client name via: supabase.from('projects').select('title, status, deadline, clients(name)').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(5)). Status badge: pill with color: Pending=gold text, In Progress=blue, Completed=green, On Hold=gray. Page title: 'Dashboard'.

Create src/pages/ClientsPage.tsx: fetch all non-archived clients on mount via supabase.from('clients').select('*').eq('is_archived', false).order('name'). Render a data table (desktop) / card list (mobile) with columns: Name, Company, Email, Phone, Location, Actions. Actions: Edit button (opens ClientModal pre-filled), Archive button (calls supabase.from('clients').update({ is_archived: true }).eq('id', id) then removes from local state). Header row has an 'Add Client' button (brand_red background, cream text) that opens ClientModal in add mode. onSaved callback: for add, prepend to local state array; for edit, replace matching item. Show a loading spinner while fetching. Show empty state message 'No clients yet. Add your first client.' when list is empty. Page title: 'Clients'.

Create src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: fetch all projects joined with client name on mount via supabase.from('projects').select('*, clients(name)').order('created_at', { ascending: false }). Also fetch all non-archived clients (for the ProjectModal dropdown). Render a data table with columns: Title, Client, Service, Status, Deadline, Budget, Actions. Actions: Edit button (opens ProjectModal pre-filled). Status filter: a row of pill buttons (All / Pending / In Progress / Completed / On Hold) that filter the displayed list client-side. Header row has 'Add Project' button. onSaved: same prepend/replace pattern as ClientsPage. Page title: 'Projects'.
Update the stub DashboardPage, ClientsPage, ProjectsPage that were created in FEAT-002 with the full implementations above (replace the stub files entirely).

Run `npm run build` inside agency-ams/ and fix all TypeScript errors. Common issues to watch: Supabase joined relation types (use 'as any' cast only as last resort; prefer explicit typed selects), optional chaining on nullable fields, exhaustive status type checks.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors — all three pages, two modals, and two SQL files in place
DashboardPage shows 4 stat cards and a recent projects table
ClientsPage shows client list with Add/Edit/Archive actions and ClientModal opens correctly
ProjectsPage shows project list with status filter pills, Add/Edit actions, and ProjectModal opens with client dropdown populated
Both SQL migration files are syntactically valid PostgreSQL with RLS enabled and policies defined
No service-role key appears anywhere in src/

Build: npm run build exited 0 — 1689 modules transformed, no TypeScript errors. dist/assets/index-*.css = 16.00 kB, dist/assets/index-*.js = 428.80 kB. Supabase joined query type for projects (clients relation) handled via ProjectRow interface extending Project with clients: { name: string } | null to avoid TypeScript errors on the joined column.
